name: Hintersteiner See
kurzbeschreibung: Lake Hintersteiner See at 882 metres near Scheffau is celebrated as one of Tirol's cleanest alpine lakes, set in the Wilder Kaiser nature reserve with a panoramic circuit.
preis: Lakeshore loop freely accessible; beach lido at eastern shore applies admission
oeffnungszeiten: Lakeshore paths open year-round; swimming facilities operate mid-May to mid-September
beschreibung:
Überblick

The breathtaking Hintersteiner See rests at an elevation of 882 metres in a sunlit elevated valley above Scheffau, embraced by the pristine Wilder Kaiser nature reserve. Spanning approximately 56 hectares with depths reaching 36 metres, this turquoise mountain jewel is widely celebrated as one of the purest and visually stunning alpine lakes in Austria. The lake is continuously replenished by subterranean springs funneling cold, crystalline meltwaters directly from the towering limestone massifs of the Wilder Kaiser. Water transparency frequently reaches ten metres, endowing the lake with its iconic turquoise to deep sapphire hues. In the calm water, the jagged stone battlements of the Scheffauer and Treffauer peaks mirror with razor sharpness. A charming natural lido at the eastern shore invites swimmers to take an invigorating dip, while an enchanting circular walking trail delights families and hikers across all four seasons.

Route & Anforderungen

The roughly five-kilometre circuit encircling Lake Hintersteiner See is a scenic masterclass requiring approximately 1.5 to 2 hours of walking time and roughly 100 metres of elevation change. The trail traces the car-free southern shore along a root-strewn forest singletrack hovering directly above the water, while the northern segment follows a quiet, paved country lane on the hillside above. Numerous vantage points provide sublime photo opportunities across the lake toward the Kaiser crags. Sturdy hiking shoes with gripping rubber soles are strongly advised for the woodland path along the south bank (unsuitable for wheeled strollers due to stone steps). However, families with prams can easily enjoy an out-and-back stroll along the paved northern road.

Besuch & Anreise

Travel by car follows motorway A12 (exit Kufstein Süd or Wörgl Ost) along federal highway B178 to Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser, where a signposted mountain road ascends to the lake. Paid visitor parking is available at the lakeshore. Alternatively, visitors can take the convenient and eco-friendly 'Hintersteiner See Wanderbus' shuttle running frequently from Scheffau village center.

Tipps

Take a relaxing break on the sun deck of the historic Gasthof Goingstätt or Café Seestüberl. Savoring traditional Tyrolean bacon dumplings or warm blueberry cake while gazing over the shimmering turquoise water toward the sheer rock spires of the Wilder Kaiser is pure mountain indulgence.
